checks.lead: Jacques Roumain (French pronunciation: [ʒak ʁumɛ̃]; June 4, 1907 – August 18, 1944) was a Haitian writer and politician, considered one of the most prominent figures in Haitian literature. Ideologically a Marxist and communist, Roumain helped establish a number of leftist organizations, foremost the Haitian Communist Party, which he led until his exile in 1936.
